plan.summary:
Raises the upload retry limit from 3 to 5 attempts in `config/upload.yaml`.

- Only `retry.max_attempts` changes.
- `backoff_ms` stays at 200, so each retry waits the same time as before.
- Failed uploads can now take longer before they give up.
plan.riskRationale: One configuration value changes. It affects retry behavior only. The code that reads the value was not changed and was not shown.
plan.storyArc: One config value changes so uploads retry up to five times instead of three. There is only one topic.

topics.title: Raise upload retry limit to five attempts
topics.narrativeBrief: What does the new `retry.max_attempts` value change for uploads? Verify how the setting is read, and whether `max_attempts` counts the first try or only the retries.
